scenes.create.title: Generate AI Backgrounds
scenes.create.description: Create product scenes with POST /v1/scene/create. The JSON response lists temporary image URLs or storage URIs; this call does not download image bytes.

object.description: Product image and placement. image_url is an https URL or a storage:// URI in the JSON body.

image_url.description: Product image URL or storage:// URI.

scene.description: Background scene. Provide a prompt, a template, or an effect.

model.description: Scene model. v2 is the flagship model.

prompt.description: Text prompt, or an object that asks Claid to generate one.

anyOf.description: Scene prompt.
Autoprompt settings.

negative_prompt.description: Terms to exclude from the scene.

template_url.description: Reference image URL or storage:// URI.

template_mode.description: How closely the background follows the template.

color.description: Hex background color or a named color.

view.description: Camera view such as front, top, or auto.

output.description: Where generated scene images are stored.

anyOf.description: Destination folder URI. Storage folders end with /.
Scene output options.

number_of_images.description: How many images to create. Default 4.

images.background.remove.title: Remove Background
images.background.remove.description: Remove an image background with one POST /v1/image/edit JSON call. The response carries a temporary image URL, not image bytes.

input.description: Source image URL or storage:// URI.

remove.description: True to remove the background, or category and clipping settings.

anyOf.description: Remove the whole background.
Category hint and clipping.
Storage URI or temporary destination for the processed image.
Format and destination for the processed image.

destination.description: Destination URI. Storage URIs use the storage:// scheme.

storages.get.title: Get Storage Details
storages.get.description: Read one connected storage with GET /v1/storage/storages/{storage_id}.

storageId.description: Storage id. Composio calls this storage_id.

storages.create.title: Connect New Storage
storages.create.description: Connect an S3, GCS, or web folder storage with POST /v1/storage/storages. parameters is the official JSON object.

parameters.description: Connector parameters. Cloud buckets require a bucket and credentials. A web folder requires base_url.

anyOf.description: S3 or GCS bucket parameters. Credentials are sent only on create or update.

path.description: Optional prefix prepended to object keys.

credentials.description: Cloud access keys. The secret is not returned by later reads.

anyOf.description: Web folder parameters. base_url is stored by Claid; this connector still calls only api.claid.ai.

base_url.description: Base URL of the web folder Claid will read.

images.resize.generative.title: Generative Resize
images.resize.generative.description: Outpaint an image to a new canvas with one POST /v1/image/edit JSON call. The response carries a temporary image URL, not image bytes.

input.description: Source image URL or storage:// URI.

operations.description: Generative resize. Fit must be outpaint.

width.description: Output width in pixels, auto, or a percentage.

anyOf.description: Size in pixels.
Size as auto or a percentage such as 150%.

height.description: Output height in pixels, auto, or a percentage.

anyOf.description: Size in pixels.
Size as auto or a percentage such as 150%.

fit.description: Outpaint fit. A string or an object with feathering.

anyOf.description: Generate the new canvas edges.
Outpaint fit options.

outpaint_by.description: Extra canvas on each side, for example 20% 10%.

anyOf.description: Storage URI or temporary destination for the processed image.
Format and destination for the processed image.

destination.description: Destination URI. Storage URIs use the storage:// scheme.

images.aiEdit.title: Image AI Edit Async
images.aiEdit.description: Submit one text-driven edit with POST /v1/image/ai-edit. The JSON body is the accepted task, including result_url. This operation does not poll that URL.

input.description: Source image URL or storage:// URI.

anyOf.description: Destination URI.
Output count, destination, and format.

guidance_scale.description: How closely the edit follows the prompt.

images.edit.batch.title: Image Edit Batch
images.edit.batch.description: Submit one batch edit with POST /v1/image/edit/batch. The JSON body is the accepted job, including result_url. This operation does not poll that URL.

input.description: One image URL, a list of image URLs, or a storage folder.

anyOf.description: One public image URL or storage:// URI.
Public image URLs.
Storage folder input.

source.description: Storage folder URI, for example storage://name/folder/.

operations.description: Image editing operations applied to every image in the batch.

adjustments.description: HDR, exposure, saturation, contrast, or sharpness.

output.description: Optional output folder URI or format object.

anyOf.description: Storage URI or temporary destination for the processed image.
Format and destination for the processed image.

destination.description: Destination URI. Storage URIs use the storage:// scheme.

images.generate.title: Generate AI Images
images.generate.description: Generate images from a text prompt with POST /v1/image/generate. The JSON response lists temporary image URLs; this call does not download image bytes.

options.description: How many images to generate and how closely to follow the prompt.

guidance_scale.description: Prompt adherence. Values from 5 to 7 are typical.

output.description: Optional storage folder URI. It must end with /.

images.privacy.blurPlate.title: Blur License Plates
images.privacy.blurPlate.description: Blur license plates with one POST /v1/image/edit JSON call that sets privacy.blur_car_plate. The response carries a temporary image URL, not image bytes.

input.description: Source image URL or storage:// URI.

anyOf.description: Storage URI or temporary destination for the processed image.
Format and destination for the processed image.

destination.description: Destination URI. Storage URIs use the storage:// scheme.

storages.update.title: Update Connected Storage
storages.update.description: Update a connected storage with PATCH /v1/storage/storages/{storage_id}. Send only the fields that change.

storageId.description: Storage id. Composio calls this storage_id.

parameters.description: Partial storage parameters. Send only the fields to change.

path.description: Optional prefix prepended to object keys.

base_url.description: Base URL of a web folder.

images.polish.title: Polish Image
images.polish.description: Polish an image with one POST /v1/image/edit JSON call that sets restorations.polish. The response carries a temporary image URL, not image bytes.

input.description: Source image URL or storage:// URI.

anyOf.description: Storage URI or temporary destination for the processed image.
Format and destination for the processed image.

destination.description: Destination URI. Storage URIs use the storage:// scheme.

images.smartFrame.title: Smart Frame
images.smartFrame.description: Place an image on a canvas with padding using one POST /v1/image/edit JSON call and fit canvas. The response carries a temporary image URL, not image bytes.

input.description: Source image URL or storage:// URI.

options.description: Canvas size, padding, and optional background color.

padding.description: Padding on each side, for example 10% 25% or 30px.

inputSchema.description: No input. Lists every storage on the account.

storages.types.title: List Storage Types
storages.types.description: List storage connector types with GET /v1/storage/storage-types. Claid returns a JSON array of type names.

inputSchema.description: No input. Lists the supported storage types.
